layout.alt: The window: menu bar, page tabs, page header and status bar

marks.label: Main menu
marks.text: Every page, by area. Hover a heading to see its pages.

marks.label: Search or jump to (Ctrl K)
marks.text: Type a page, enterprise, trunk, rate table, rule or user. Your favourite pages come first.

marks.label: Live TPS
marks.text: Messages per second right now, over the whole platform.

marks.label: Alerts
marks.text: Open incidents. A red count means something needs a look.

marks.label: Your menu
marks.text: Theme (light, dark, blue-grey), My changes, password, alert sounds and sign out.

marks.label: Page tabs
marks.text: Each page opens in a tab. Drag a tab out to give it its own window.

marks.label: Split view
marks.text: Two pages side by side in one window.

marks.label: Help for this page
marks.text: Opens the help topic of the page you are on.

marks.label: Status bar
marks.text: Rows shown, keyboard shortcuts, and live/autosave state.

grids.alt: A list page: quick search, column filters, views and columns

marks.label: Quick search
marks.text: Type to search. Pick a field from the list to turn your text into a filter pill.

marks.label: Column filter
marks.text: Every column has a filter under its title. `%` matches anything, `_` one character.

marks.label: Pick-list filter
marks.text: Columns with fixed values filter with a checklist.

marks.label: Views
marks.text: Save the filters, sorting and columns you use often, and open them again in one click.

marks.label: Columns
marks.text: Show, hide and reorder columns.

marks.label: Sort
marks.text: Click a column title to sort; click again to reverse.

marks.label: Select rows
marks.text: Tick rows for the actions in the header (Clone, Delete, Edit, More).

marks.label: New rule
marks.text: Opens the full rule window: general, configuration, conditions and vendors, saved with one Save.

marks.label: Simulate
marks.text: Test which rule and vendor a message would take, before or after a change.

marks.label: Undo and History
marks.text: Undo your last save, or see every change to rules.

marks.label: Row actions
marks.text: Clone, Delete, Edit and More act on the ticked rules. Clone opens a prefilled New rule window.

marks.label: Trunk filters
marks.text: A trunk search also finds rules that apply to all trunks.

marks.label: On / off
marks.text: Click the dot to turn a rule on or off.

marks.label: Vendors
marks.text: Hover for each vendor's share, cost and live volume. Click a row to open its detail panel.

rate-manager.alt: Rate manager list of rate tables

marks.label: Customer or vendor
marks.text: Switch between customer (selling) and vendor (buying) rate tables.

marks.label: New rate table
marks.text: Create an empty table, then add rates or import a sheet.

marks.label: Send rates
marks.text: E-mail the current rate sheet to every live customer trunk using the ticked tables. A summary shows who got it.

marks.label: Open a table
marks.text: Click a name to open the table: rates, history, and editable rate cells (dashed boxes).

marks.label: Negative margin
marks.text: Filter tables that sell below cost somewhere.

rate-lookup.alt: Rate lookup with customer and vendor sides

marks.label: Search both sides
marks.text: One search for destination, country or MCCMNC on both sides at once.

marks.label: Layouts
marks.text: Side by side, one destination at a time, or the advanced lookup.

marks.label: Side filters
marks.text: Narrow each side by product, trunk, country or network.

marks.label: Expand a destination
marks.text: Click a destination row to see every table's rate for it.

marks.label: Live / Pause
marks.text: Figures stream in place. Pause to read them still; the tab shows a light while live.

marks.label: Period
marks.text: Today, yesterday, last 7 days, months, or any range with the date chip.

marks.label: Columns
marks.text: Pick the figures to show, grouped by Traffic, Quality, Billing and Network.

marks.label: Search rows
marks.text: Starts-with search on the names in the first column.

marks.label: Sort
marks.text: Click any column title to sort high to low; again for low to high.

marks.label: Expand a row
marks.text: Click a name to break it down (by trunk, vendor, country…). Double-click for its detail.

marks.label: Today's figures
marks.text: Attempts, submitted and delivered, money, ASR/DLR, TPS, who is online, and market moves.

marks.label: Refresh
marks.text: How often the dashboard updates. Live = every second.

marks.label: Panels
marks.text: Show or hide panels. Drag a panel by its corner handle to rearrange.

marks.label: Top lists
marks.text: Click a row to open its Live analytics view in a new tab.

marks.label: Template
marks.text: Switch the columns in one click. "All message details" shows everything about each message.

marks.label: Period
marks.text: The time range searched. Today by default.

marks.label: Number or message ID
marks.text: Type a phone number or a message ID, or pick a field to filter on.

marks.label: Columns
marks.text: Add or remove single columns on top of the template.

marks.label: Open a message
marks.text: Click a row for every detail of that message and its receipts.

marks.label: New enterprise
marks.text: Add a partner. Customer and vendor trunks are added inside its record.

marks.label: Open the record
marks.text: General info, documents, billing, contacts, trunks and rules, in tabs.

marks.label: Search
marks.text: Find by name, brand or ID, or pick a field to filter on.

marks.label: Customer trunk
marks.text: The trunk the test message comes in on.

marks.label: Receivers
marks.text: One or more numbers, or switch to destination mode to pick networks.

marks.label: Simulate
marks.text: Shows the matching rule, every vendor with why it would or would not get the message, and shadowed rules.
